contexts.text: With one who is stupid there is what is stupid in everything of his will and thought.
(The learned) are sometimes more stupid than others. AC 4156:2. HH 464:3. HH 464:4.
In the other life such are more stupid than others.
Such induce stupidities on the brain.
They live in such stupidity that they have scarcely anything left of what is human as to apprehension.
Spirits ascribe this to the stupidity of man.
Because he had led an evil life, he was in such stupid ignorance...
Such are deprived of all intelligence, and become most stupid.
Such become so gross and stupid as to their thoughts and affections, that no one in the world can be more stupid.
One in whom there was so little of the life of intelligence... that you would say he was stupidity in effigy.
They wondered at the stupidity (of the Spirits from this Earth).
They are sometimes let into a state of darkness... and speak with fatuity; for they are in stupidity.
They relate to the mucus of the nostrils, and are dull and stupid.
(Such as have despised others) are in a kind of stupidity; for such arrogance extinguishes the light of Heaven, and consequently intelligence.
After vastation (such) are slow, dull, stupid...
Thus the internal is closed, (which) occasions stupidity in spiritual things.
The inhabitants of this side of Venus are stupid. Described.
(This Spirit) was exceedingly stupid. Described.
When Spirits are deprived of wisdom and intelligence, which is the case when the angelic Societies are removed from them... they become stupid, and have no perception of what is true and good...
He was cunning in seducing, although stupid as to the things of Heaven.
The Angels regard them as stupid, and as thieves; as stupid, because they constantly look to themselves...
They who at heart have denied the Divine... have become so stupid that they can comprehend scarcely any civil truth...
Men are obese and stupid as to spiritual truths in proportion as they indulge the taste, etc.
Those who are corporeal loves are stupid, and as it were fools.
Such, in this second state, are more stupid than all others. For in proportion as anyone loves himself, he is removed from Heaven...
They thought of nothing except from self, thus were stupid, like corporeal sensuous Spirits.
The Africans call clever wickedness stupidity, because there is... death in it.
They who ascribe all things to their Own intelligence... become first like drunkards, then like fools, and finally stupid.
A man who is not quite stupid... can understand these things.
Every man, unless born a fool, or in the highest degree stupid, can come to reason itself...
The stupidity which characterizes those who have once embraced faith alone.
That the heresy of faith alone induces stupidity, etc. on hearts. Signified, Explained.
[152a]. Not that they have become so stupid from the want of instruction; but that they have made themselves so stupid through the fallacies of the senses.
For the stupid commonalty.
(Adulterers) at last become stupid; not that the faculty of being wise is taken away from them; but that they do not want to be wise.
This induces a stupid faith. Described.
Can there be a blinder stupidity respecting regeneration...
Those clever in externals are stupid there. Explained.
One who has indulged (in philosophy) is stupid there.

All could be such (as I) if the Lord pleased, even the most stupid; and I was reminded of a certain stupid man... who, at certain times held forth, and things which at other times he could never know or remember, were then called to his mind.
Without speech in a Society... a Spirit knows nothing, and is so stupid...
Man thinks and speaks analytically... But when he thinks, etc. according to the knowledge (of it) ... he becomes insane and stupid...

Whenever these Sirens came, they brought stupid spirits, who, in the world, had been learned... The stupid learned ones appeared on the right in the plane of the head... I could then scarcely write anything... as I often told the stupid ones; but they did not apprehend, because the Sirens inspired into them that they were learned.
(After vastation, Charles XII was stupid.)
They who are at last taken out of these Hells... are stupid...
They who have had no thought except of self and the world, after vastation, ... are stupid.
There is a great gulf (which contains) a vast multitude (of such) very stupid ones... who are protected as much as possible from influx from the Hells. Described.
Thus (these preachers) live (in Hell) in a certain stupidity. Described.
They who relate to the nails... finally become the most stupid of all. Such is Cartouche.
These become most stupid. They appear like corpses; and do not know that they are men.
The most wicked ones are near the northern quarter, remotely there, for the reason that these, when vastated, become the most stupid of all. Explained.
The lot (of the cunning and deceitful) is that they become more stupid than all others... and therefore they dwell near the north, where are the most stupid ones.
The celestial, unless they hear truths, and thus see them, are stupid; for they do not think.
Leeuwenhoek is stupid. Explained.
In the Hells there, all become most stupid, and the more stupid in proportion as they are more remotely in the west at the northern line.
They who without fear of the Divine attempt evils in secret, and enjoy understanding in such things pre-eminently, become more stupid than others.
Finally (Lang) became stupid.
a. [end]. They are then not in intelligence, but in a certain stupidity.
(Thus) Spirits who had been without Divine truths for so many ages... become more stupid.
James Benzelius wanted all things of his doctrine of faith alone to be taken away, and genuine truths to be given in their stead. This was done; but he was as stupid as one who had known nothing.
He against whom G. Benzelstierna poured out his sarcasms became as it were stupid, and... could not retort.
Such are now accounted wise, when yet they are more stupid than the most simple person.
The affection then immerses itself in the affection of self... and thus becomes more stupid...
These at last become... so stupid, that no stupidity of anyone in the world is like it.
When the thought which the lukewarm have had from the Word is taken away, they become the most stupid of all.
Wonder at such gross stupidity. Signified.
They are as stupid in such things as are essential to faith and life, as they are clever in scheming evils and persuading falsities.
When the Corporeal Sensuous is separated from the Rational, it is stupid.
Thus they become merely sensuous, who are the most stupid of all in spiritual things and thence in rational ones; and are the most astute of all in worldly ones.
Profaners of this kind are stupid and foolish in spiritual things; but are astute and clever in worldly ones. Explained.
